target: PDT-II (1)/(2): test whether Jacobi derived from smooth reversible composition can non-circularly select n=3.

matrix_commutator_jacobi.statement: In every associative matrix algebra, the commutator satisfies Jacobi by direct expansion.

so_n_closure.statement: For skew-symmetric A,B, [A,B] is skew-symmetric, hence so(n) is closed under commutator for every n.

jacobi_dimension_selector.statement: Jacobi coherence inherited from reversible matrix composition is satisfied by so(n) for every n and cannot select n=3.

generator_state_dimension_match.statement: dim so(n)=n(n-1)/2 equals n only for positive n=3, but identifying the entire generator sector with an n-dimensional state/vector sector is not derived by Jacobi.

pdt_native_closure.statement: PDT must derive why physically primitive reversible generators are exhausted by an n-dimensional state-like sector, or find another pre-Hodge dimension-sensitive principle.

dimension_ledger_summary.higher_dimension_check: deterministic structured basis triples; theorem itself proved algebraically for all n

smallest_non3_counterexample.statement: so(2) satisfies Jacobi, so Jacobi survives outside n=3 at the smallest nontrivial rotation dimension.

prior_art_boundary: Lie groups/Lie algebras, matrix-commutator Jacobi and dim so(n)=n(n-1)/2 are standard mathematics. No novelty is claimed.
surviving_obligation: Find a PDT-native operational/resource derivation of generator-state closure or another dimension-sensitive principle.
